assignments.name: salary_min
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const m = ($json.salary || '').match(/\d[\d.,]*/g); if (!m || !m.length) return null; const n = m[0].replace(/[.,](\d{1,2})$/, '').replace(/[.,]/g, ''); return n ? Number(n) : null; })() }}

assignments.name: salary_max
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const m = ($json.salary || '').match(/\d[\d.,]*/g); if (!m || m.length < 2) return null; const n = m[1].replace(/[.,](\d{1,2})$/, '').replace(/[.,]/g, ''); return n ? Number(n) : null; })() }}

assignments.name: group
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const u = decodeURIComponent($json.inputUrl || ''); if (u.includes('BI Analyst')) return 'A'; if (u.includes('Data Engineer')) return 'B'; if (u.includes('Data Scientist')) return 'C'; if (u.includes('Business Analyst')) return 'D'; return '?'; })() }}

parameters.content:
## START HERE - how to run this

**Automatic:** the `Schedule Trigger` node scans on its own on a schedule (check its cron expression).
**Manual:** click "Execute workflow" to scan right now.

Results land in your Google Sheet's **Job_Posts** tab, and you get a summary email.

Review the sheet yourself: read the scores, and whenever you want to apply to something,
mark it in the sheet (e.g. a note or status column) however works for you.

## YOUR SEARCH TERMS - edit the `Keywords DE` node

Open that node. It's a plain list -- put in the job titles you're looking for.

Every term is searched on EVERY source (sources x terms = number of paid calls).
Cost scales with list length -- trimming the list saves more than any prompt tweak will.

When you add a term, check BOTH filters:
- The per-source filters (in each `*Filter` node) may exclude words like `senior`,
  `lead`, `principal`, `head of`.
- The `Relevance Filter` node checks the title for data/analysis keywords -- if your new
  term doesn't look like one of those, add a keyword for it there too, or the term gets
  searched but every result gets silently dropped.

## FIRST-TIME SETUP - connect your own accounts

Every credential in this workflow has been removed. Any node with a red (!) warning
needs you to attach your own credential. All secrets now live ONLY in n8n's
Credentials vault -- never typed directly into a node field, so they can't leak
again if you ever export/share this workflow.

- `Adzuna HTTP` -> create a **Custom Auth** credential whose JSON is
  `{"qs": {"app_id": "<your id>", "app_key": "<your key>"}}` (free at developer.adzuna.com)
- `LinkedIn DE Apify` / `XING Apify` / `StepStone Apify` / `Indeed Apify` -> one
  **Header Auth** credential, Name=`Authorization`, Value=`Bearer <your Apify token>`
- `Claude Haiku Scoring` / `Warm Prompt Cache` -> Anthropic API key
- `Read Job Posts` / `Write Job Posts` / `Append Run Log` / other Sheets nodes -> Google Sheets
- `Send a message` / `Source Down Mail` -> Gmail
- `Arbeitsagentur HTTP` -> no key needed

See the 10 small notes scattered across the canvas below for exactly where each one
goes -- each is parked under the section of the workflow it belongs to.

These sources scan ALL of Germany -- there's no city filter at the search step. WHERE
you want to work is handled at scoring time (see `Score Location & Language`), not here.

## CV SELECTION AND SCORING - edit `Prepare AI Scoring Prompt`

**The most important node in this workflow.** It holds the full text of your CV(s)
(`CV_LIBRARY`) and a short `CFG` block.

**`CV_LIBRARY`** -- for every job ad, the AI reads all of your CVs and picks whichever
fits best. Replace the placeholder text with your real CV text; add/remove/rename CV
variants freely, they just need the same `{ file, label, targets, text }` shape.

**`CFG`** -- only the preferences your CV doesn't already say: home city, hub cities,
relocation, salary target, experience years, and what roles you're targeting.

**SCORING, 0-100, two parts:**
- The **AI** scores only CV-to-ad fit (`cv_match_score`) and extracts facts from the ad.
- The **`Score Location & Language`** node scores location, language and experience
  years with plain code (no prompt editing needed -- just edit the constants there,
  and make sure `CANDIDATE_YEARS` matches `CFG.experience_years`).

`total = match x 0.50 + experience x 0.25 + language x 0.15 + location x 0.10`

Tune the location points, language-level table and experience penalty for yourself in
`Score Location & Language`. Thresholds: edit `BANDS` there too (defaults:
75+ = strong_apply, 60+ = apply, 45+ = maybe, below = skip -- adjust freely).

`new_cv_needed = TRUE` rows mean none of your CVs was a great fit -- might be worth
writing a new variant for that kind of role.

## YOUR GOOGLE SHEET

Create a Google Sheet with (at least) these two tabs:

- **`Job_Posts`** -- every scored job lands here
- **`runs`** -- one row per scan, written by `Append Run Log`

(Optional tabs used by a few extra nodes if you want run stats per source:
`Filtered_Out`, `LinkedIn_Stats`, `XING_Stats`, `Indeed_Stats`, `Adzuna_Stats`,
`Arbeitsagentur_Stats`, `StepStone_Stats` -- delete those nodes if you don't want them.)

Open every Google Sheets node (`Write Job Posts`, `Read Job Posts`, `Append Run Log`,
etc.) and point `documentId` at your own sheet's ID (the long id in its URL).

This sheet is your dashboard -- read scores there, and `Send a message` emails you
a summary after every run.

parameters.content:
### EDIT -> `Keywords DE`
*(the node right above this note)*

Put YOUR job titles in the list, one per entry. Each one is searched on
EVERY source (6 sources x N keywords = N*6 paid calls per run), so keep the
list as short as you can live with -- this is the single biggest cost lever
in the whole workflow.

Also bump `LOOKBACK_DAYS` here if you want a wider/narrower date window.

### CREDENTIAL -> `Adzuna HTTP`
*(the node above-left, first column of sources)*

1. Sign up free at developer.adzuna.com for an `app_id` + `app_key`.
2. In n8n: Credentials -> New -> **Custom Auth**.
3. Its JSON: `{"qs": {"app_id": "YOUR_ID", "app_key": "YOUR_KEY"}}`
4. Open this node -> Credential for "Custom Auth" -> select it.

Nothing to type into the node itself -- the credential supplies both values.

### CREDENTIAL -> 4 nodes above
`LinkedIn DE Apify` · `XING Apify` · `StepStone Apify` · `Indeed Apify`

1. Get your token from the Apify console (Settings -> Integrations).
2. In n8n: Credentials -> New -> **Header Auth**.
   Name = `Authorization`  ·  Value = `Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`
3. Open EACH of the 4 nodes above -> attach this SAME credential to all four.

One credential, reused 4 times -- you only ever type the token once.

### EDIT -> `Relevance Filter`
*(further right, after Dedup)*

This keeps only titles that look like the kind of role you want, and
silently drops everything else -- even if it matched a search term.

If you're NOT searching for data/analytics roles, open this node and
rewrite the `DATA` keyword list near the top for your own field, or your
results will come back empty with no error.

### CREDENTIAL + ID -> every `googleSheets` node
`Read/Write Job Posts` · `Append Run Log` · `Read Run History` ·
`Read/Write Filtered Out` · the `Write *_Stats` nodes · `Read Applied`

1. Create a Google Sheet with at least a `Job_Posts` tab and a `runs` tab.
2. Copy its ID out of the URL (the long string between /d/ and /edit).
3. In n8n: Credentials -> New -> Google Sheets (OAuth2) -> sign in.
4. Open EACH node above -> set the credential AND paste your Sheet ID into
   `documentId`.

Also paste the same ID into the `SHEET_ID` constant inside `Format e-mail`
(further along, near the Gmail nodes) so the summary email links to your sheet.

### EDIT -> `Prepare AI Scoring Prompt`
*(the big node in the middle -- the most important one here)*

`CV_LIBRARY`: replace every placeholder `text` with the real text of one of
YOUR CVs. Add/remove/rename variants freely.

`CFG`: your home city, hub cities, salary target, years of experience,
target roles -- whatever your CV doesn't already say.

Also read the "OPTIONAL -- ADD YOUR OWN HARD-GAP RULES HERE" paragraph
inside this node's code -- delete it, or replace it with a rule specific
to a requirement you know you don't meet.

### CREDENTIAL -> `Claude Haiku Scoring` + `Warm Prompt Cache`
*(further right along the scoring path)*

1. Get an API key at console.anthropic.com.
2. In n8n: Credentials -> New -> Anthropic.
3. Open BOTH nodes above -> attach the same credential to each.

If you'd rather use a different Claude model, change the `model` field in
each node's JSON body (both nodes must use the same model to share the
prompt cache).

### EDIT -> `Score Location & Language`
*(near Claude Haiku Scoring)*

This is plain code, not AI -- three separate things to set for yourself:

- `LOCATION_POINTS` + the remote/hybrid/onsite fallback points -> YOUR
  home city and hub cities.
- `CANDIDATE_YEARS` -> must match `CFG.experience_years` in
  `Prepare AI Scoring Prompt` -- the two are NOT linked automatically.
- the German/English level table (`DE_BASE`) -> YOUR real proficiency.

Also `BANDS` in the same node sets the strong_apply/apply/maybe/skip
thresholds -- tune those once you see real scores coming through.

### CREDENTIAL + ADDRESS -> `Send a message` + `Source Down Mail`
*(near the end of the flow, by Format e-mail)*

1. In n8n: Credentials -> New -> Gmail (OAuth2) -> sign in.
2. Open BOTH nodes above -> attach the credential, and set `sendTo` to
   YOUR email address on both.

`Send a message` sends your daily summary; `Source Down Mail` only fires
if a source's API/scraper breaks.

### OPTIONAL -> `Healthcheck Ping`
*(the very last node)*

Right now its URL is a placeholder and does nothing. If you want to know
WHEN the schedule silently stops firing (it won't error, it just won't
run), sign up free at healthchecks.io, create a check, and paste its ping
URL in here.

Not required to run the workflow -- just removes a blind spot.
